name: OMathFunction
description: Represents a mathematical function or structure that Microsoft Word supports, such as fractions, integrals, sums, and radicals. The OMathFunction object is a member of the OMathFunctions collection.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns a WdOMathFunctionType constant that represents the type of function. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathFunction object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained in the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Args
properties.description: Returns an OMathArgs object that represents the arguments for an equation. Read-only.

properties.name: Acc
properties.description: Returns an OMathAcc object that represents a base character with a combining accent mark. Read-only.

properties.name: Bar
properties.description: Returns an OMathBar object that represents the mathematical overbar for an object. Read-only.

properties.name: Box
properties.description: Returns an OMathBox object that represents an invisible box around an equation or part of an equation to which you can apply properties that affect the mathematical or formatting properties, such as line breaks. Read-only.

properties.name: BorderBox
properties.description: Returns an OMathBorderBox object that represents a border drawn around an equation or part of an equation. The BorderBox object can also be used to draw horizontal, vertical, and diagonal strikethrough lines through the BorerBox arguments. Read-only.

properties.name: Delim
properties.description: Returns an OMathDelim object that represents the delimiter function. Read-only.

properties.name: EqArray
properties.description: Returns an OMathEqArray object that represents an equation array function. Read-only.

properties.name: Frac
properties.description: Returns an OMathFrac object that represents a fraction. Read-only.

properties.name: Func
properties.description: Returns an OMathFunc object that represents a type of mathematical function that consists of a function name, such as sin or cos, and an argument. Read-only.

properties.name: GroupChar
properties.description: Returns an OMathGroupChar object that represents a horizontal character placed above or below text in an equation, often with the purpose of grouping the text visually. Read-only.

properties.name: LimLow
properties.description: Returns an OMathLimLow object that represents the lower limit for a function. Read-only.

properties.name: LimUpp
properties.description: Returns an OMathLimUpp object that represents upper limit function. Read-only.

properties.name: Mat
properties.description: Returns an OMathMat object that represents a mathematical matrix. Read-only.

properties.name: Nary
properties.description: Returns an OMathNary object that represents the n-ary operation. Read-only.

properties.name: Phantom
properties.description: Returns an OMathPhantom object that represents an object used for advanced layout of an equation. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrPre
properties.description: Returns an OMathScrPre object that represents a superscript and subscript to the left of the base. Read-only.

properties.name: Rad
properties.description: Returns an OMathRad object that represents the mathematical radical function. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrSub
properties.description: Represents an OMathScrSub object that represents the mathematical subscript function. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrSubSup
properties.description: Returns an OMathScrSubSup object that represents a mathematical subscript-superscript object that consists of a base, a subscript, and a superscript. Read-only.

properties.name: ScrSup
properties.description: Returns an OMathScrSup object that represents the mathematical superscript function. Read-only.

properties.name: OMath
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the equation. Read-only.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a function from the collection of functions contained within an equation and returns an OMathFunction object.
